description:
Earn Lifetime Commissions with MicroVitamin!

Join our mission to promote healthier living by sharing the benefits of MicroVitamin. When someone makes their first purchase using your unique link, you earn a 5% commission.

But it doesn’t stop there! Once a customer buys through your link, they become your lifetime referral. This means for every subsequent purchase they make, you'll continue to earn a 5% commission – even if they don't use your link again.

This is the heart of our Lifetime Commissions program. It's not just about earning; it's about building a community dedicated to health and wellness. Be a part of this journey, and let's make a lasting impact together!
term_and_condition:
MicroVitamin Affiliate Program — Terms and Conditions


These terms apply to everyone using the program: MicroVitamin ("we", "the merchant") and you, the affiliate who refers customers to us. By joining, you agree to these terms. If you don't agree with them in full, please don't register or take part.


1. Registration

We may approve or reject any affiliate registration at our sole discretion, and may remove an affiliate who breaches these terms.


2. Commission structure

You earn 10% of a referred customer's first order and 5% of their later orders, calculated on the order value excluding tax and shipping. We may update the program, including commission rates, as it grows; we will give notice before any change, and changes apply to future orders only.


3. Links and coupon codes

Your affiliate link is generated automatically; you can also create links for a specific product or collection. If a customer clicks more than one affiliate's link, the most recent click counts. If you're assigned a coupon code, its details appear on your dashboard; a customer who both clicks your link and uses your code generates one commission, not two. If you haven't been assigned a code, don't promote one.


4. Genuine referrals only

Commissions are paid on customers you genuinely referred.


No coupon or deal sites. Posting your code or link on coupon, voucher, or deal sites (or in browser coupon extensions) is not allowed. Commissions generated that way will not be paid, and repeat violations end your participation.

No self-referral. Orders you place for yourself through your own link or code are not referrals and earn no commission. We review referral orders under a fair-use policy and may reject any that don't meet these terms.

5. No paid advertising

You may not use any form of paid advertising to promote MicroVitamin or drive traffic through your link — including Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and any other pay-per-click, paid search, paid social, or paid placement. Promote through organic channels only: your own content, social media, email list, blog, YouTube, podcast, and word of mouth. Violation means immediate termination and forfeiture of unpaid commissions.


6. What you may say

Don't make medical or disease claims about our products, and don't present them as treating, curing, or preventing any condition. We provide approved wording and materials (see section 7); when in doubt, use those or ask us first.


7. Marketing materials

We may share banners, logos, and promotional media through the Marketing tool tab. You can download these or use the embed code on your channels.


8. Payment

Add your payment details under Settings; the payment schedule is on the Affiliate Guide page. Commissions are paid on successfully completed transactions only — orders that are refunded or charged back are not paid. Commission status appears in the Commission tab and payments in the Payment tab.


9. Tracking and cookies

We track referrals with a cookie set when someone clicks your link or uses your code. The cookie duration is stated on the registration form; orders within that window credit to you without another click. If a customer blocks or clears cookies, we can't track them and can't pay commission on their orders.


10. Leaving the program

To be removed from the program, email brad@microvitamin.com. Questions about these terms can go to the same address.
